senses.gloss: m. (v. שָׁתוּק) one belonging to the class of שָׁתוּק, esp. an illegitimate child of unknown fatherhood.
units: Ib. 2 ש׳ כל שהוא מכיר וכ׳ a sh’thuḳi is he who knows his mother, but does not know who his father is, contrad. to אסופי.

Yeb. 100ᵇ עשרה … הוולד ש׳ if ten priests stood together, and one (unknown which) separated and had intercourse, the child is a sh’thuḳi (admitted neither to inheritance nor to priesthood); Keth. 13ᵇ; a. e.—Fem. שְׁתוּקִית.
Kidd. 73ᵃ אלא מעתה שתוקי ש׳ לא ישא if this be so, let a sh’thuḳi not be permitted to marry a woman whose father is unknown.
Ib. בת ש׳ the daughter of a sh’thuḳith (who married a sh’thuḳi, a mamzer, etc.).
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:5">Esth. R. to II, 7</cite> (not <he>שתוקת</he>); a. e.
